newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes unchanged, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes unchanged, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed unchanged in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 582.61 from 582.77 on Thursday.
Trade volume was 2.224 million dinars against 978,000 dinars. Main exchanges were on over-the-couter with a turnover of 1.4 million dinars.
Banque Nationale Agricole was up 0.5 dinar to 33.8 dinars. ($=one dinar)
